title: Lubbock, TX — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]

content:
Overview

Lubbock is a city in TX with a population of 263,930. Hub City with Texas Tech, Buddy Holly, and the flattest terrain you’ll ever see. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 264 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 30.4.
